prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production high-resolution animal animation sprite atlas. Input image 1 is the character identity/style reference. 
Subject: Octopus. The dolphin reference is STYLE ONLY. Make a natural reddish-brown octopus with softly shaded low-poly 3D volumes, eight muscular tapering arms with suckers, a rounded mantle and small realistic side eyes. No smiling human mouth, no giant eyes, no baby-toy mascot look.
Action: 八腕卷动. Facing the exact reference viewing direction. FIRST HALF, chronological frames 0 through 7 of 16: gradually move from the resting/contact pose toward the middle action peak. For walking or swimming, use successive small, evenly spaced motion increments, actual alternating foot contact/passing/push phases or fin movements. For gestures, keep the torso steady and change the relevant body parts gradually. Never substitute whole-image wiggling. Each frame is a complete connected animal, with all body parts naturally joined.
EXACT layout: TWO columns and FOUR rows, EIGHT equal cells, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom on a PORTRAIT 2:3 canvas. No extra poses or species. Fixed torso/grip centre and fixed ground line in every cell; constant body size. 
Use most of each cell with 7% transparent padding. Entire silhouette and tail/feet/wings must fit wholly inside its cell. Render crisp native details, softly lit sculpted volume, richly coloured material; desired 2048x3072 resolution. Fully transparent alpha outside each animal, NO shadows, NO coloured or black haze, NO ground, NO scenery, NO props, NO labels, NO text, NO borders. Do not use flat cut-paper silhouettes or an additional art style.
